objects.description: Exception type for oneDNN C++ API capturing a dnnl_status_t and a message. Thrown by wrap_c_api upon C API failure. Use what() for message; status holds the originating dnnl_status_t.
RAII wrapper over dnnl_engine_t providing construction by kind/index, querying kind, and counting available engines. Uses handle<dnnl_engine_t> ownership model.
RAII wrapper over dnnl_stream_t providing creation on an engine with flags, retrieval of associated engine, and wait() for completion. Inherits handle<dnnl_stream_t>.
Enumeration of engine kinds (any, cpu, gpu) used to select or query engine type.
Bitmask flags controlling stream behavior (in_order, out_of_order, default_flags, optionally profiling). Operators enabled via DNNL_DEFINE_BITMASK_OPS.
Enumeration selecting allowed implicit downconversions for floating-point computations: strict, bf16, f16, tf32, any.
Enumeration selecting accumulation precision policy for computations: strict, relaxed, any, and explicit s32/f32/f16 accumulator types.
Specialization of handle_traits that binds dnnl_engine_destroy as the destructor for dnnl_engine_t handles.
Specialization of handle_traits that binds dnnl_stream_destroy as the destructor for dnnl_stream_t handles.

Abstract C++ interface for threadpool integration with oneDNN. Users subclass this pure-virtual interface and provide an instance to oneDNN CPU streams or BLAS functions so oneDNN can execute parallel work. Key methods: get_num_threads() returns worker count; get_in_parallel() indicates if the current thread is a worker within this pool; parallel_for(n, fn) schedules n tasks invoking fn(i, n); get_flags() exposes behavior flags; wait() synchronizes when using asynchronous behavior. The static ASYNCHRONOUS flag indicates that parallel_for returns immediately and oneDNN is responsible for waiting; otherwise behavior is synchronous. No ownership or construction helpers are defined here; users implement and manage subclasses themselves.

threadpool_iface is referenced as an interface pointer parameter and return type but is not defined in this header. The definition is provided in the included oneapi/dnnl/dnnl_threadpool_iface.hpp. Since there is no definition here, it is not a type defined by this header.

No custom types are defined in this header. It only includes another header (oneapi/dnnl/dnnl_debug.h) and contains include guards. Types referenced or defined in the included header are out of scope for this task.

No types are defined in this header. It only includes another header: oneapi/dnnl/dnnl_version.h. Any types such as dnnl_version_t would be defined in the included header, not here. Therefore, there are no custom data types to extract from this file.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_next_impl
functions.description: Advance a primitive descriptor to the next available implementation variant. Use to iterate over implementations for the same op configuration.
requirements: primitive_desc must be a valid, initialized primitive descriptor.
On success returns dnnl_success; returns dnnl_last_impl_reached when no further implementations are available and leaves primitive_desc unchanged.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_clone
functions.description: Create a new primitive descriptor that is a clone of an existing one. The clone must be destroyed separately.
requirements: primitive_desc must be non-NULL and point to storage for the output handle.
existing_primitive_desc must be a valid primitive descriptor.
Caller must later destroy the cloned primitive descriptor with dnnl_primitive_desc_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_get_attr
functions.description: Get a constant reference to the attributes associated with a primitive descriptor.
requirements: primitive_desc must be a valid primitive descriptor.
attr must be non-NULL; on success receives a pointer to internal attributes owned by primitive_desc.
Do not destroy or modify the returned attr; its lifetime is tied to primitive_desc.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a primitive descriptor and release its resources.
requirements: primitive_desc may be NULL (no-op by convention) or a valid descriptor created by the API.
Do not use primitive_desc after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_query
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_desc_query(const_dnnl_primitive_desc_t primitive_desc, dnnl_query_t what, int index, void *result);
functions.description: Generic query interface to obtain information (memory descs, counts, strings, etc.) from a primitive descriptor.
requirements: primitive_desc must be valid.
what must be a supported query type for the primitive.
result must point to appropriately-typed storage for the queried item (e.g., dnnl_memory_desc_t* for MD queries).
index selects which entity to query when applicable (e.g., exec arg MD).

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_query_md
functions.signature: const_dnnl_memory_desc_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_desc_query_md(const_dnnl_primitive_desc_t primitive_desc, dnnl_query_t what, int index);
functions.description: Convenience helper to query a memory descriptor pointer from a primitive descriptor.
requirements: primitive_desc must be valid.
what must be a memory-descriptor-related query (e.g., dnnl_query_exec_arg_md, dnnl_query_src_md, etc.).
Returns a pointer to a zero MD if not required; returns NULL on error. Do not modify the returned descriptor.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_desc_query_s32
functions.signature: int DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_desc_query_s32(const_dnnl_primitive_desc_t primitive_desc, dnnl_query_t what, int index);
functions.description: Convenience helper to query a 32-bit integer value from a primitive descriptor.
requirements: primitive_desc must be valid.
what must correspond to an int32_t query; otherwise returns 0 (which may also be a legitimate value).

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_create
functions.description: Instantiate a primitive from a primitive descriptor.
requirements: primitive must be non-NULL and receive the output handle.
primitive_desc must be a valid descriptor created for the current engine configuration.
Caller must destroy the primitive with dnnl_primitive_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_create_from_cache_blob
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_create_from_cache_blob(dnnl_primitive_t *primitive, const_dnnl_primitive_desc_t primitive_desc, size_t size, const uint8_t *cache_blob);
functions.description: Create a primitive using a previously obtained cache blob for faster initialization.
requirements: primitive must be non-NULL.
primitive_desc must match the cache blob (same engine/config).
cache_blob must be non-NULL if size > 0; size must match the blob length.
Caller must destroy the primitive with dnnl_primitive_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_execute
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_execute(const_dnnl_primitive_t primitive, dnnl_stream_t stream, int nargs, const dnnl_exec_arg_t *args);
functions.description: Execute a primitive on a stream with a set of bound memory arguments.
requirements: primitive must be a valid, created primitive.
stream must be a valid stream compatible with the primitive's engine.
args must contain nargs entries mapping DNNL_ARG_* indices to memory objects.
Unless runtime dims are used, each memory must match the primitive's expected exec arg MD (query via dnnl_primitive_desc_query_md).
If any provided memory is padded, inputs are assumed zero-padded and outputs produced zero-padded.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_get_primitive_desc
functions.description: Get a const reference to the primitive descriptor embedded in a primitive.
requirements: primitive must be valid.
primitive_desc must be non-NULL; receives an internal const descriptor owned by the primitive. Do not destroy it.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_get_cache_blob
functions.description: Retrieve the cache blob associated with a primitive for later fast recreation.
requirements: primitive must be valid.
If cache_blob is NULL, size must be non-NULL to receive required size.
If cache_blob is non-NULL, size must specify the buffer capacity and at least the required size.
Cache blob may be empty; caller should check size==0 before reuse.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a primitive and release its resources.
requirements: primitive may be NULL (no-op by convention) or a valid primitive.
Do not use the primitive after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_create
functions.description: Create a new primitive attributes object with default values.
requirements: attr must be non-NULL to receive the handle.
Empty/default attributes are implied when passing NULL in APIs that accept attributes.
Caller must destroy attributes with dnnl_primitive_attr_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_clone
functions.description: Clone an existing primitive attributes object.
requirements: attr must be non-NULL.
existing_attr must be a valid attributes handle.
Caller must destroy the cloned attributes with dnnl_primitive_attr_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a primitive attributes object.
requirements: attr may be NULL (no-op) or a valid attributes handle.
Do not use the attributes after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_dropout
functions.description: Get the dropout attribute as a memory descriptor (probability/output descriptor).

dropout_desc must be non-NULL; receives a const pointer to the internal memory descriptor representing dropout settings.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_dropout

requirements: attr must be a valid, mutable attributes handle.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_deterministic

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_deterministic

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_accumulation_mode

mode must be non-NULL.

requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
mode must be one of dnnl_accumulation_mode_t values.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_scratchpad_mode

functions.description: Configure per-argument scaling factors via a mask; actual scale values must be provided at execution time using DNNL_ARG_ATTR_SCALES | arg.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be a DNNL_ARG_* index for which scales apply.

requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be a DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask defines correspondence; group_ndims and group_dims define grouping for masked logical dims.
data_type specifies the datatype of scales.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_scales_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_scales_v2(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, int mask, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t group_dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, int is_on_host);

requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be a DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask/ndims/group_dims specify mapping.
data_type specifies scales datatype.
is_on_host boolean indicates host scalar scale.
qmode must be dnnl_quantization_mode_static_sazp or dnnl_quantization_mode_dynamic_mx.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points_mask
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points_mask(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, int mask);
functions.description: Configure per-argument zero points via a mask; actual values provided at execution using DNNL_ARG_ATTR_ZERO_POINTS | arg.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be a DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask defines per-dimension zero-point mapping; 0 for common zero point.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, int mask, int group_ndims, const dnnl_dims_t group_dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type);
functions.description: Configure zero points mapping (with grouping) and datatype; values provided at execution via DNNL_ARG_ATTR_ZERO_POINTS | arg.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask/group_ndims/group_dims define mapping for masked dims.
data_type specifies zero point datatype.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_precomputed_reductions
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_precomputed_reductions(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, int mask, int group_ndims, const dnnl_dims_t group_dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type);
functions.description: Configure precomputed reductions attribute for a given argument; values must be provided at execution via DNNL_ARG_ATTR_PRECOMPUTED_REDUCTIONS | arg.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be a DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask/group mapping must be consistent with tensor dims.
data_type specifies precomputed reduction datatype.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_zero_points_v2(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, int mask, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t group_dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, int is_on_host);
functions.description: Configure zero points with grouping and mark if a single host-side scalar zero point is used.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be DNNL_ARG_* index.
mask/ndims/group_dims define mapping.
data_type specifies zero point datatype.
is_on_host boolean indicates host scalar zero-point.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_rounding
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_set_rounding(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, dnnl_rounding_mode_t mode);
functions.description: Set rounding mode attribute for a specific argument.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
arg must be an argument id for which rounding applies.
mode must be a valid dnnl_rounding_mode_t.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_rounding
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_primitive_attr_get_rounding(dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr, int arg, dnnl_rounding_mode_t *mode);
functions.description: Get rounding mode attribute for a given argument.
requirements: attr must be valid.
mode must be non-NULL.
arg must be the argument previously set or default.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_get_post_ops
functions.description: Get a const reference to the post-ops sequence in attributes.
requirements: attr must be valid.
post_ops must be non-NULL; receives pointer to internal object. Do not modify/destroy. Lifetime tied to attr.

functions.name: dnnl_primitive_attr_set_post_ops
functions.description: Set the post-ops sequence on attributes.
requirements: attr must be valid and mutable.
post_ops must be a valid post-ops handle. Note: support for given post-ops is validated when creating the primitive descriptor, not here.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_create
functions.description: Create an empty post-ops sequence object.
requirements: post_ops must be non-NULL to receive handle.
Caller must destroy with dnnl_post_ops_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_clone
functions.description: Clone a post-ops object.
requirements: post_ops must be non-NULL.
existing_post_ops must be a valid handle.
Caller must destroy cloned object with dnnl_post_ops_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a post-ops sequence.
requirements: post_ops may be NULL (no-op) or a valid handle.
Do not use after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_len
functions.description: Get the number of entries in a post-ops sequence.
requirements: post_ops must be a valid handle.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_kind
functions.description: Get the kind (sum, eltwise, binary, convolution, prelu, etc.) of a post-op at a given index.
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must be in [0, dnnl_post_ops_len()). Returns dnnl_undefined_primitive if out of range.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_sum
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_append_sum(dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, float scale, int32_t zero_point, dnnl_data_type_t data_type);
functions.description: Append a sum (accumulation v3) post-op with optional zero point and data type reinterpretation.
requirements: post_ops must be a valid, mutable post-ops handle.
scale is a float multiplier; zero_point is a scalar int32.
If data_type is specified, it must be same size as destination data type (reinterpretation).

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_sum
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_sum(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, float *scale, int32_t *zero_point, dnnl_data_type_t *data_type);
functions.description: Retrieve parameters of a sum post-op at index.
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must point to a sum post-op.
scale, zero_point, and data_type must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_eltwise
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_append_eltwise(dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, dnnl_alg_kind_t alg_kind, float alpha, float beta);
functions.description: Append an elementwise post-op with given algorithm and parameters.
requirements: post_ops must be valid and mutable.
alg_kind must be a supported eltwise algorithm.
alpha and beta semantics depend on alg_kind.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_eltwise
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_eltwise(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, dnnl_alg_kind_t *alg_kind, float *alpha, float *beta);
functions.description: Retrieve parameters for an elementwise post-op at index.
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must refer to an eltwise post-op, else returns dnnl_invalid_arguments.
alg_kind, alpha, beta must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_dw
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_append_dw(dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, dnnl_data_type_t weights_data_type, dnnl_data_type_t bias_data_type, dnnl_data_type_t dst_data_type, dnnl_dim_t kernel_size, dnnl_dim_t stride_size, dnnl_dim_t padding_l_size);
functions.description: Append a depthwise convolution post-op that can be fused after a 1x1 conv.
requirements: post_ops must be valid and mutable.
Only applicable for fusion with 2D 1x1 convolution.
Data types and spatial parameters must be consistent with the intended fusion.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_dw
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_dw(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, dnnl_data_type_t *weights_data_type, dnnl_data_type_t *bias_data_type, dnnl_data_type_t *dst_data_type, dnnl_dim_t *kernel_size, dnnl_dim_t *stride_size, dnnl_dim_t *padding_l_size);
functions.description: Get parameters of a depthwise convolution post-op.
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must point to a depthwise post-op.
All output pointers must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_binary
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_append_binary(dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, dnnl_alg_kind_t alg_kind, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t src1_desc);
functions.description: Append a binary post-op with broadcast-capable second operand descriptor.
requirements: post_ops must be valid and mutable.
alg_kind must be a supported binary algorithm.
src1_desc must be a valid memory descriptor with same ndims as dst; broadcasting supported along dims of size 1.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_binary_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_append_binary_v2(dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, dnnl_alg_kind_t alg_kind, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t src1_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t src2_desc);
functions.description: Append a binary post-op that optionally uses a ternary (third) operand; broadcasting only supported for the second operand.
requirements: post_ops must be valid and mutable.
alg_kind must support ternary if src2_desc is intended; otherwise src2_desc is ignored.
src1_desc and src2_desc must be valid MDs with same ndims as dst (no broadcasting for src2).

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_binary
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_binary(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, dnnl_alg_kind_t *alg_kind, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t *src1_desc);
functions.description: Get parameters for a binary post-op (second operand).
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must refer to a binary post-op else returns dnnl_invalid_arguments.
alg_kind and src1_desc must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_binary_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_binary_v2(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, dnnl_alg_kind_t *alg_kind, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t *src1_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t *src2_desc);
functions.description: Get parameters for a binary post-op with ternary input (second and third operand descriptors).
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must refer to a binary post-op else returns dnnl_invalid_arguments.
alg_kind, src1_desc, src2_desc must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_append_prelu
functions.description: Append a PReLU post-op; weights are provided at execution time with a layout implied by mask.
requirements: post_ops must be valid and mutable.
mask defines per-dimension weights mapping; 0 for common weight.
Weights are provided in runtime as f32 using plain layouts.

functions.name: dnnl_post_ops_get_params_prelu
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_post_ops_get_params_prelu(const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops, int index, int *mask);
functions.description: Get the mask for a PReLU post-op.
requirements: post_ops must be valid.
index must refer to a PReLU post-op.
mask must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a memory descriptor object created via API calls that allocate it.
requirements: memory_desc may be NULL (no-op) or a valid handle.
Do not use after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_clone
functions.description: Clone a memory descriptor; result must be destroyed separately.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL to receive new handle.
existing_memory_desc must be valid.
Caller must destroy the clone with dnnl_memory_desc_destroy().

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_get_blob
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_get_blob(uint8_t *blob, size_t *size, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t memory_desc);
functions.description: Serialize a memory descriptor to a binary blob or query required blob size.
requirements: memory_desc must be valid.
If blob is NULL, size must be non-NULL to receive required size.
If blob is non-NULL, size must specify capacity; at least required size.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_blob
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor from its serialized binary blob.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL to receive handle.
blob must be a valid pointer to a serialized memory descriptor.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_strides
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_strides(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, const dnnl_dims_t strides);
functions.description: Create a blocked (plain) memory descriptor from dims and strides.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
ndims must be valid for the library (>=0) and match dims/strides lengths.
dims and strides must be non-NULL and define a consistent layout.
data_type must be a valid dnnl_data_type_t.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_tag
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_tag(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, dnnl_format_tag_t tag);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor from dims and a format tag (or any).
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
ndims, dims must be valid.
data_type and tag must be valid; tag may be dnnl_format_tag_any.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_csr_encoding
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_csr_encoding(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, dnnl_dim_t nnz, dnnl_data_type_t indices_dt, dnnl_data_type_t pointers_dt);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor for CSR sparse encoding.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
ndims/dims must be valid; nnz is number of non-zeros.
indices_dt and pointers_dt must be valid data types.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_coo_encoding
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_coo_encoding(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, dnnl_dim_t nnz, dnnl_data_type_t indices_dt);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor for COO sparse encoding consisting of values and per-dimension indices buffers.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
ndims/dims valid; nnz specifies number of non-zeros.
indices_dt must be valid.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_packed_encoding
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_with_packed_encoding(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims, dnnl_data_type_t data_type, dnnl_dim_t nnz);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor placeholder for packed sparse encoding; used only to derive actual MD via primitive descriptor query (cannot create memory directly).
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
ndims/dims valid; nnz is number of non-zeros.
This MD cannot be used to create a memory object directly.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_host_scalar
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor for a scalar value stored on host.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
data_type must be valid and represent the scalar type.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_create_submemory
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_create_submemory(dnnl_memory_desc_t *memory_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t parent_memory_desc, const dnnl_dims_t dims, const dnnl_dims_t offsets);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor describing a subregion of a parent memory layout.
requirements: memory_desc must be non-NULL.
parent_memory_desc must be a valid MD.
dims and offsets must define a region within the parent; certain combinations may be unsupported and fail.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_reshape
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_reshape(dnnl_memory_desc_t *out_memory_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t in_memory_desc, int ndims, const dnnl_dims_t dims);
functions.description: Create a new memory descriptor by reshaping another (blocked or any). Ensures physical layout consistency.
requirements: out_memory_desc must be non-NULL.
in_memory_desc must have format_kind dnnl_blocked or dnnl_format_kind_any.
ndims/dims define the new logical shape; reshape fails if padding or blocking prevents a consistent mapping.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_permute_axes
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_permute_axes(dnnl_memory_desc_t *out_memory_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t in_memory_desc, const int *permutation);
functions.description: Create a memory descriptor by permuting axes of an existing one (blocked or any), adjusting layout to remain consistent.
requirements: out_memory_desc must be non-NULL.
in_memory_desc must be valid and have acceptable format_kind.
permutation must be an array of size in_md->ndims that defines a permutation of axes.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_query
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_query(const_dnnl_memory_desc_t memory_desc, dnnl_query_t what, void *result);
functions.description: Query properties of a memory descriptor (dims, data type, strides, inner blocks, etc.).
requirements: memory_desc must be valid.
what must be a supported MD query.
result must point to storage of the expected type per query (e.g., dnnl_dims_t**, int32_t*, etc.).

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_query_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_desc_query_v2(const_dnnl_memory_desc_t memory_desc, dnnl_query_t what, int index, void *result);
functions.description: Like dnnl_memory_desc_query, with index support for buffer-specific queries (e.g., per-buffer data type in sparse encodings).
requirements: memory_desc must be valid.
what must be a supported MD query (including sparse queries).
index selects which buffer for queries like data_type.
result must be correctly typed storage.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_equal
functions.description: Compare two memory descriptors for equality.
requirements: lhs and rhs must be valid.
Returns 1 if equal, 0 otherwise.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_get_size
functions.description: Get the total size in bytes required by the described memory.
requirements: memory_desc must be valid.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_desc_get_size_v2
functions.description: Get the size in bytes of the buffer corresponding to a given index (for multi-buffer sparse encodings).
requirements: memory_desc must be valid.
index selects the buffer per encoding.

functions.name: dnnl_data_type_size
functions.description: Return the size in bytes of a data type.
requirements: data_type must be a valid enum value.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_create(dnnl_memory_t *memory, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t memory_desc, dnnl_engine_t engine, void *handle);
functions.description: Create a memory object for a given descriptor and engine with a single data handle or library allocation.
requirements: memory must be non-NULL to receive handle.
memory_desc must be valid.
engine must be a valid engine.
handle must be one of: user pointer, DNNL_MEMORY_ALLOCATE, or DNNL_MEMORY_NONE.
If handle != DNNL_MEMORY_NONE, underlying storage is set (library owns it if DNNL_MEMORY_ALLOCATE).

functions.name: dnnl_memory_create_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_create_v2(dnnl_memory_t *memory, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t memory_desc, dnnl_engine_t engine, int nhandles, void **handles);
functions.description: Create a memory object with multiple underlying handles as defined by the memory descriptor (e.g., sparse encodings).
requirements: memory must be non-NULL.
memory_desc and engine must be valid.
nhandles and handles must match descriptor expectations; each handle can be user pointer, DNNL_MEMORY_ALLOCATE, or DNNL_MEMORY_NONE.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_create_host_scalar
functions.description: Create a host-side scalar memory object by copying the scalar value pointed to by scalar_ptr.
requirements: memory must be non-NULL.
memory_desc must describe a host scalar (created via dnnl_memory_desc_create_host_scalar).
scalar_ptr must point to host memory of the same data type as memory_desc.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_get_memory_desc
functions.description: Get a copy of the memory descriptor of a memory object.
requirements: memory must be valid.
memory_desc must be non-NULL; receives a copy (caller must destroy via dnnl_memory_desc_destroy).

functions.name: dnnl_memory_get_engine
functions.description: Get the engine associated with a memory object.
requirements: memory must be valid.
engine must be non-NULL to receive the engine handle.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_map_data
functions.description: Map a memory object and get a host pointer to a buffer copy for engines that require explicit mapping. Exclusive until unmapped.
requirements: memory must be valid.
mapped_ptr must be non-NULL to receive pointer.
All primitives using this memory should be completed before mapping (synchronize the stream).
Performance may be suboptimal; intended mainly for debug/testing.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_map_data_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_map_data_v2(const_dnnl_memory_t memory, void **mapped_ptr, int index);
functions.description: Map a specific underlying buffer of a memory object and get a host pointer to its contents. Exclusive until unmapped.
requirements: memory must be valid.
mapped_ptr must be non-NULL.
index selects which buffer to map.
Ensure operations complete before mapping; see notes on performance.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_unmap_data
functions.description: Unmap a previously mapped memory buffer and commit changes back.
requirements: memory must be valid.
mapped_ptr must be the pointer returned by dnnl_memory_map_data().

functions.name: dnnl_memory_unmap_data_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_unmap_data_v2(const_dnnl_memory_t memory, void *mapped_ptr, int index);
functions.description: Unmap a specific previously mapped buffer of a memory object and commit changes.
requirements: memory must be valid.
mapped_ptr must match the pointer from dnnl_memory_map_data_v2().
index must match the mapped buffer index.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_get_data_handle
functions.description: Get the underlying data handle for a memory object (pointer for CPU/USM; cl_mem for OpenCL).
requirements: memory must be valid.
handle must be non-NULL to receive the pointer/handle.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_set_data_handle
functions.description: Set the underlying data handle for a memory object (pointer for CPU/USM; cl_mem for OpenCL).
requirements: memory must be valid and mutable.
handle must be a valid storage handle for the engine.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_get_data_handle_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_get_data_handle_v2(const_dnnl_memory_t memory, void **handle, int index);
functions.description: Get the underlying handle for a specific buffer index of a memory object.
requirements: memory must be valid.
handle must be non-NULL.
index selects the buffer.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_set_data_handle_v2
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_memory_set_data_handle_v2(dnnl_memory_t memory, void *handle, int index);
functions.description: Set the underlying handle for a specific buffer index of a memory object.
requirements: memory must be valid and mutable.
handle must be valid for the engine.
index selects the buffer.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_get_host_scalar_value
functions.description: Read the value stored in a host-side scalar memory object into a host pointer.
requirements: memory must be a host-side scalar memory object.
value must point to storage of the same data type as the scalar.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_set_host_scalar_value
functions.description: Set the value of a host-side scalar memory object from a host pointer (the value is copied).
requirements: memory must be a host-side scalar memory object.
value must point to a scalar of the memory's data type.

functions.name: dnnl_memory_destroy
functions.description: Destroy a memory object.
requirements: memory may be NULL (no-op) or a valid memory handle.
Do not use after destruction.

functions.name: dnnl_reorder_primitive_desc_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_reorder_primitive_desc_create(dnnl_primitive_desc_t *reorder_primitive_desc, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t src_desc, dnnl_engine_t src_engine, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t dst_desc, dnnl_engine_t dst_engine, const_dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr);
functions.description: Create a primitive descriptor for memory reorder between src and dst descriptors on given engines.
requirements: reorder_primitive_desc must be non-NULL.
src_desc/dst_desc must be valid MDs; src_engine/dst_engine valid engines (can differ).
attr may be NULL or valid attributes.

functions.name: dnnl_concat_primitive_desc_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_concat_primitive_desc_create(dnnl_primitive_desc_t *concat_primitive_desc, dnnl_engine_t engine, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t dst_desc, int n, int concat_dimension, const_dnnl_memory_desc_t const *src_descs, const_dnnl_primitive_attr_t attr);
functions.description: Create a primitive descriptor for out-of-place concatenation over a dimension.
requirements: concat_primitive_desc must be non-NULL.

functions.name: dnnl_set_primitive_cache_capacity
functions.description: Set the global primitive cache capacity. Setting to 0 clears and disables the cache.
requirements: capacity must be a non-negative integer; concurrently modifying is safe.

functions.name: dnnl_set_jit_dump
functions.description: Enable or disable dumping of JIT-generated code (overrides DNNL_JIT_DUMP).
requirements: enable is a boolean flag (0/1).

functions.name: dnnl_set_jit_profiling_flags
functions.description: Set library profiling flags controlling profilers integration (overrides DNNL_JIT_PROFILE).
requirements: flags is a bitmask of DNNL_JIT_PROFILE_* values; passing DNNL_JIT_PROFILE_NONE disables profiling.

functions.name: dnnl_set_jit_profiling_jitdumpdir
functions.description: Set JIT dump output directory (Linux only) used when perf jitdump profiling is enabled; overrides JITDUMPDIR.
requirements: dir may be NULL to revert to default; must be a valid path if non-NULL.
Takes effect when first JIT kernel is generated; on Windows returns dnnl_unimplemented.
Profiling will be disabled if directory cannot be created/accessed.

functions.name: dnnl_set_max_cpu_isa
functions.description: Set the maximal CPU ISA the library may dispatch to (overrides env). Takes effect only once and must be called before any other oneDNN API.
requirements: isa must be a valid dnnl_cpu_isa_t value (or dnnl_cpu_isa_default to remove restrictions).
Must be called before any other API call; returns error otherwise or if unsupported at build time.

functions.name: dnnl_get_effective_cpu_isa
functions.description: Get the maximal CPU ISA the library may currently dispatch to.

functions.name: dnnl_set_cpu_isa_hints
functions.description: Set CPU ISA hints influencing implementation choices (overrides env). Takes effect only once and must be called before any other oneDNN API.
requirements: isa_hints must be a valid dnnl_cpu_isa_hints_t (or dnnl_cpu_isa_no_hints).
Must be called before other API calls; may return runtime_error or unimplemented depending on build.

functions.name: dnnl_get_cpu_isa_hints
functions.description: Get the ISA-specific hints the library can follow.

functions.name: dnnl_reset_profiling
functions.description: Reset profiler state for a given stream (experimental profiling APIs guarded by DNNL_EXPERIMENTAL_PROFILING).
requirements: stream must be a valid stream whose profiling to reset.

functions.name: dnnl_query_profiling_data
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_query_profiling_data(dnnl_stream_t stream, dnnl_profiling_data_kind_t data_kind, int *num_entries, uint64_t *data);
functions.description: Query profiling data accumulated for primitive executions on a stream since last reset. If data is NULL, returns num_entries only.
requirements: stream must be valid.
Must wait for all submitted primitives to complete (dnnl_stream_wait) prior to querying.
If data is NULL, num_entries must be non-NULL; when data is non-NULL, provide a buffer large enough to hold num_entries of the requested kind.

functions.name: dnnl_sgemm
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_sgemm(char transa, char transb, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const float *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, const float *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, float beta, float *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc);
functions.description: Single-precision GEMM for row-major matrices: C := alpha*op(A)*op(B) + beta*C. Returns status instead of XERBLA.
requirements: transa/transb must be 'N'/'n' or 'T'/'t'.
M,N,K,lda,ldb,ldc must be non-negative and consistent with row-major leading dimensions.
A,B,C pointers must reference arrays sized per dimensions.
alpha and beta are scalars applied as in BLAS semantics.

functions.name: dnnl_gemm_u8s8s32
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_gemm_u8s8s32(char transa, char transb, char offsetc, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const uint8_t *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, uint8_t ao, const int8_t *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, int8_t bo, float beta, int32_t *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc, const int32_t *co);
functions.description: Integer GEMM: u8 A, s8 B, s32 C with offsets: C := alpha*(op(A)-ao)*(op(B)-bo) + beta*C + C_offset. Row-major layout.
requirements: transa/transb in {'N','n','T','t'}.
offsetc in {'F','C','R'} determines co length requirement (F: >=1; C: >=max(1,M); R: >=max(1,N)).
M,N,K,lda,ldb,ldc non-negative and consistent.
A,B,C non-NULL and sized per dims; co points to required number of offsets.
Beware potential saturation on some architectures (see docs).

functions.name: dnnl_gemm_s8s8s32
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_gemm_s8s8s32(char transa, char transb, char offsetc, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const int8_t *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, int8_t ao, const int8_t *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, int8_t bo, float beta, int32_t *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc, const int32_t *co);
functions.description: Integer GEMM: s8 A, s8 B, s32 C with offsets: C := alpha*(op(A)-ao)*(op(B)-bo) + beta*C + C_offset. Row-major.
requirements: transa/transb in {'N','n','T','t'}.
offsetc in {'F','C','R'} determines co length requirement (F: >=1; C: >=max(1,M); R: >=max(1,N)).
M,N,K,lda,ldb,ldc non-negative and consistent.
A,B,C non-NULL and sized per dims; co points to required number of offsets.
Beware potential saturation on some architectures (see docs).

functions.name: dnnl_engine_get_count
functions.description: Returns the number of engines available of the specified kind. Use this to query the valid index range before creating an engine.
requirements: kind must be a valid dnnl_engine_kind_t value

functions.name: dnnl_engine_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_engine_create(dnnl_engine_t *engine, dnnl_engine_kind_t kind, size_t index);
functions.description: Creates an engine of the given kind at the specified index and returns it via the output parameter. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: engine must be a non-null pointer to receive the created engine
kind must be a valid dnnl_engine_kind_t value
index must be in the range [0, dnnl_engine_get_count(kind)) as explicitly documented

functions.name: dnnl_engine_get_kind
functions.description: Retrieves the engine kind for the given engine handle and stores it in the output parameter. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: engine must be a valid dnnl_engine_t obtained from the library
kind must be a non-null pointer to receive the result

functions.name: dnnl_engine_destroy
functions.description: Destroys (releases) an engine handle. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status. After destruction, the handle must not be used.
requirements: engine must be a valid engine handle previously created by the library
engine must not be used after this function returns

functions.name: dnnl_stream_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_stream_create(dnnl_stream_t *stream, dnnl_engine_t engine, unsigned flags);
functions.description: Creates an execution stream on the given engine with the specified behavior flags and returns it via the output parameter. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: stream must be a non-null pointer to receive the created stream
engine must be a valid engine handle
flags must be composed according to dnnl_stream_flags_t (0 or a valid combination as defined by that enum)

functions.name: dnnl_stream_get_engine
functions.description: Retrieves the engine associated with a stream and stores it in the output parameter. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: stream must be a valid stream handle
engine must be a non-null pointer to receive the result

functions.name: dnnl_stream_wait
functions.description: Blocks until all primitives enqueued in the execution stream finish computation. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: stream must be a valid execution stream handle

functions.name: dnnl_stream_destroy
functions.description: Destroys (releases) an execution stream handle. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status. After destruction, the handle must not be used.
requirements: stream must be a valid execution stream handle previously created by the library
stream must not be used after this function returns

functions.name: dnnl_get_default_fpmath_mode
functions.description: Gets the current default floating-point math mode used for subsequently created primitives and stores it in the output parameter. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: mode must be a non-null pointer to receive the current mode

functions.name: dnnl_set_default_fpmath_mode
functions.description: Sets the default floating-point math mode for subsequently created primitives. Returns dnnl_success on success, otherwise an error status.
requirements: mode must be one of: dnnl_fpmath_mode_strict, dnnl_fpmath_mode_bf16, dnnl_fpmath_mode_f16, dnnl_fpmath_mode_tf32, or dnnl_fpmath_mode_any (as explicitly documented)

functions.name: dnnl_set_verbose
functions.description: Configures verbose output to stdout. Level 0 disables verbose output, 1 prints primitive/graph info at execution, and 2 prints at creation/compilation and execution. Returns dnnl_success on success, or dnnl_invalid_arguments if level is invalid. Note: enabling verbose output affects performance and overrides the ONEDNN_VERBOSE environment variable.
requirements: level must be 0, 1, or 2; otherwise the function returns dnnl_invalid_arguments

functions.name: dnnl_version
functions.description: Returns a pointer to a constant structure describing the library version (major, minor, patch, hash). Intended for read-only introspection of the oneDNN version in use.
requirements: Caller must treat the returned pointer as pointing to immutable data

functions.name: dnnl_status2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_status_t value to a human-readable, null-terminated C string for debugging/logging. Useful for printing or diagnosing oneDNN status codes. The returned pointer refers to a non-owning string literal or library-managed storage.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_status_t enumerator.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed by the caller.
The function is intended for diagnostic/debug output; not for program logic dependent on localized text.

functions.name: dnnl_dt2str
functions.description: Returns a textual name for a dnnl_data_type_t (data type) value for debugging/logging purposes.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_data_type_t enumerator.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed by the caller.

functions.name: dnnl_fpmath_mode2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_fpmath_mode_t value to its string representation for diagnostic output.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_fpmath_mode_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_accumulation_mode2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_accumulation_mode_t value to a readable string for debugging/logging.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_accumulation_mode_t enumerator.
Returned const char* is non-owning; do not modify or free.

functions.name: dnnl_engine_kind2str
functions.description: Maps a dnnl_engine_kind_t (engine kind) to its string name for debug output.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_engine_kind_t enumerator.
Returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_sparse_encoding2str
functions.description: Returns a string name for a dnnl_sparse_encoding_t value, useful for logging/debugging sparse encodings.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_sparse_encoding_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_fmt_tag2str
functions.description: Translates a dnnl_format_tag_t (format tag) to a human-readable string for debug/diagnostic messages.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_format_tag_t enumerator.
Returned const char* is non-owning; do not modify or free.

functions.name: dnnl_prop_kind2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_prop_kind_t (propagation kind) to a string representation for diagnostics.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_prop_kind_t enumerator.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_prim_kind2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_primitive_kind_t (primitive kind) to a string for logging/debugging.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_primitive_kind_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_alg_kind2str
functions.description: Returns the string name for a dnnl_alg_kind_t (algorithm kind) value for diagnostic use.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_alg_kind_t enumerator.
The returned const char* is non-owning; do not modify or free.

functions.name: dnnl_rnn_flags2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_rnn_flags_t bitmask/enum value to a string listing the RNN flags for debugging/logging.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_rnn_flags_t value (flags as defined by the API).
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_rnn_direction2str
functions.description: Returns a human-readable name for a dnnl_rnn_direction_t value for diagnostics.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_rnn_direction_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_scratchpad_mode2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_scratchpad_mode_t to its string representation for debug/logging output.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_scratchpad_mode_t enumerator.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_rounding_mode2str
functions.description: Returns a string description of a dnnl_rounding_mode_t value, for diagnostics.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_rounding_mode_t enumerator.
Returned const char* is non-owning; do not modify or free.

functions.name: dnnl_quantization_mode2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_quantization_mode_t to a readable string for logging/debugging quantization modes.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_quantization_mode_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_cpu_isa2str
functions.description: Returns the string name for a dnnl_cpu_isa_t (CPU ISA) value for diagnostics and capability reporting.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_cpu_isa_t enumerator.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_cpu_isa_hints2str
functions.description: Converts a dnnl_cpu_isa_hints_t value to a string for logging/debugging ISA hint configurations.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_cpu_isa_hints_t enumerator.
Do not modify or free the returned const char*.

functions.name: dnnl_runtime2str
functions.description: Converts an implementation-defined runtime identifier (unsigned) to its textual name for diagnostics. The exact value set is defined by the library.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid runtime identifier as defined by the library.
The returned const char* must not be modified or freed.

functions.name: dnnl_fmt_kind2str
functions.description: Returns the string representation of a dnnl_format_kind_t (format kind) value for debugging/logging.
requirements: Argument v should be a valid dnnl_format_kind_t enumerator.
Returned const char* is non-owning; do not modify or free.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create
functions.description: Creates a ukernel attributes memory storage object used to pass runtime pointers (e.g., post-op arguments and scale buffers) to ukernel executions.
requirements: attr_params must be a non-null pointer to receive the created storage handle.
Available only when DNNL_EXPERIMENTAL_UKERNEL is enabled.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and do not use the output on failure.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_set_post_ops_args
functions.description: Associates post-operations runtime argument pointers with an attribute storage. The array is expected to contain pointers to individual post-op storages packed contiguously.
requirements: attr_params must be a valid ukernel attribute storage created by dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create.
post_ops_args must point to a contiguous array of pointers to post-op storages.
The provided pointers should remain valid for the duration of ukernel execution that consumes them.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_set_A_scales
functions.description: Sets the runtime pointer to tensor A scales in the attribute storage used by ukernel executions (e.g., BRGeMM quantization flows).
requirements: attr_params must be a valid ukernel attribute storage created by dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create.
a_scales must point to a valid scales buffer matching the configuration of the ukernel (data type/shape as implied by the kernel settings).
The scales memory must remain valid for the duration of the execution that uses it.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_set_B_scales
functions.description: Sets the runtime pointer to tensor B scales in the attribute storage used by ukernel executions. Special handling applies when the BRGeMM B-scales mask is 2.
requirements: attr_params must be a valid ukernel attribute storage created by dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create.
b_scales must point to a valid scales buffer matching the kernel configuration.
If dnnl_brgemm_set_B_scales was configured with mask == 2, b_scales must contain at least N values of the selected data type (N is the BRGeMM N dimension).
The scales memory must remain valid for the duration of the execution that uses it.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_set_D_scales
functions.description: Sets the runtime pointer to tensor D (output) scales in the attribute storage used after post-ops are applied.
requirements: attr_params must be a valid ukernel attribute storage created by dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create.
d_scales must point to a valid scales buffer matching the kernel configuration.
The scales memory must remain valid for the duration of the execution that uses it.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a ukernel attributes memory storage and releases its resources.
requirements: attr_params must be a valid attribute storage obtained from dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_create (or NULL/no-op per typical DNNL semantics is unknown; pass a valid handle).
Do not use attr_params after destruction.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_create(dnnl_brgemm_t *brgemm, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, dnnl_dim_t batch_size, dnnl_dim_t lda, dnnl_dim_t ldb, dnnl_dim_t ldc, dnnl_data_type_t a_dt, dnnl_data_type_t b_dt, dnnl_data_type_t c_dt);
functions.description: Creates a BRGeMM ukernel object that computes C = A x B with optional batching and accumulation into C.
requirements: brgemm must be a non-null output pointer to receive the created object.
c_dt must be dnnl_f32 (as required).
M, N, K, batch_size, lda, ldb, and ldc must be consistent with the actual tensor shapes and memory layout used at execution time.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and do not use the output on failure.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_add_C
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_set_add_C(dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, int add_C);
functions.description: Configures whether the kernel adds to C instead of writing: C += A x B.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object created by dnnl_brgemm_create.
add_C must be 0 (disable addition) or 1 (enable addition).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_post_ops
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_set_post_ops(dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, dnnl_dim_t ldd, dnnl_data_type_t d_dt, const_dnnl_post_ops_t post_ops);
functions.description: Sets post-operations and output tensor D parameters for a BRGeMM ukernel. When post-ops are present or when d_dt differs from the accumulation type c_dt, the final execution must use dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
ldd must be the leading dimension for tensor D consistent with its memory layout.
d_dt specifies the data type of D and may differ from c_dt; if post-ops are non-empty or d_dt != c_dt, you must use dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops as the final call in the accumulation chain.
post_ops must be a valid post-ops attribute object (may be empty to indicate no post-ops).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_A_scales
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_set_A_scales(dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, int a_scale_mask);
functions.description: Configures the scales mask for tensor A. In quantization flows, A scales are applied to the accumulation buffer once C is ready.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
a_scale_mask must be 0 (only).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_B_scales
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_set_B_scales(dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, int b_scale_mask);
functions.description: Configures the scales mask for tensor B. In quantization flows, B scales are applied to the accumulation buffer once C is ready.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
b_scale_mask must be 0 or 2 only.
If mask 2 is selected, at least N scale values are expected at execution (see attribute parameter setter).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_D_scales
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_set_D_scales(dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, int d_scale_mask);
functions.description: Configures the scales mask for tensor D (output). In quantization flows, D scales are applied after all post-ops are applied.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
d_scale_mask must be 0 (only).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_finalize
functions.description: Finalizes initialization of a BRGeMM ukernel object so it can be queried for information.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
Call this before querying information from the object (e.g., scratchpad size).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_get_B_pack_type
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_get_B_pack_type(dnnl_pack_type_t *pack_type, dnnl_data_type_t a_dt, dnnl_data_type_t b_dt);
functions.description: Returns the packing type expected by tensor B for a BRGeMM configuration defined by A and B data types.
requirements: pack_type must be a non-null output pointer.
a_dt and b_dt specify the input data types and affect the returned packing advice.

Interpretation: result may be dnnl_brgemm_pack_undef if ukernel/transform unsupported on the target, dnnl_brgemm_no_trans if no packing required, or dnnl_pack_type_pack32 for x64 backend (otherwise as returned).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_get_scratchpad_size
functions.description: Returns the size of scratchpad memory required by the given BRGeMM ukernel object.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid finalized BRGeMM ukernel object (finalization required to query info).
size must be a non-null pointer to receive the required size in bytes.
Allocate at least this many bytes and pass the pointer to execute functions.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_is_execute_postops_valid
functions.description: Indicates whether dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops is valid for the given BRGeMM object.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
valid must be a non-null pointer to receive 1 (valid) or 0 (not valid).
Use this flag to decide whether to call dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops versus dnnl_brgemm_execute.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_set_hw_context
functions.description: Initializes any required hardware-specific context for BRGeMM execution. Returns success if no initialization is required.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
Call before executing BRGeMM kernels that require hardware context.
Ensure to later call dnnl_brgemm_release_hw_context after all BRGeMM executions are finished.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_release_hw_context
functions.description: Releases the hardware-specific context previously initialized for BRGeMM ukernels. Must be used after all execution calls to BRGeMM ukernel objects.
requirements: Call only after all BRGeMM ukernel executions that rely on the hardware context have completed.
This function takes no arguments and affects the global/implicit hardware context associated with BRGeMM.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_generate
functions.description: Generates the executable component of a BRGeMM ukernel object based on its current configuration.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object.
Call after configuring the object (e.g., scales, post-ops) and before execution.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_execute
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_execute(const_dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, const void *A_ptr, const void *B_ptr, const dnnl_dim_t *A_B_offsets, void *C_ptr, void *scratchpad_ptr);
functions.description: Executes a BRGeMM ukernel object to perform batched matrix multiplication and accumulate into C using a scratchpad buffer.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid generated BRGeMM ukernel object.
A_ptr and B_ptr must be valid base pointers to tensors A and B, respectively.
A_B_offsets must point to a contiguous set of offsets for A and B for each batch; each batch supplies offsets for both A and B; the number of batches must equal the batch_size specified at creation.
C_ptr must point to the accumulation buffer (tensor C).
scratchpad_ptr must point to a buffer of at least the size reported by dnnl_brgemm_get_scratchpad_size for this object.
Use dnnl_brgemm_execute (not ..._postops) when no post-ops are required and d_dt == c_dt; otherwise follow the post-ops rules.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_brgemm_execute_postops(const_dnnl_brgemm_t brgemm, const void *A, const void *B, const dnnl_dim_t *A_B_offsets, const void *C_ptr, void *D_ptr, void *scratchpad_ptr, const_dnnl_ukernel_attr_params_t attr_params);
functions.description: Executes a BRGeMM ukernel object and applies configured post-operations, producing output D from accumulation buffer C and runtime attributes.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid generated BRGeMM ukernel object for which execute_postops is valid (see dnnl_brgemm_is_execute_postops_valid or the rules: non-empty post-ops or d_dt != c_dt).
A and B must be valid base pointers to tensors A and B, respectively.
A_B_offsets must point to a contiguous set of offsets for A and B for each batch; each batch supplies offsets for both A and B; the number of batches must equal the batch_size specified at creation.
C_ptr must point to the accumulation buffer (tensor C).
D_ptr must point to the output tensor D buffer.
scratchpad_ptr must point to a buffer of at least the size reported by dnnl_brgemm_get_scratchpad_size for this object.
attr_params must be a valid ukernel attribute storage (e.g., containing any required post-ops args and scale pointers).
When post-ops are required or d_dt != c_dt, this must be the final call of the accumulation chain instead of dnnl_brgemm_execute.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_brgemm_destroy
functions.description: Destroys a BRGeMM ukernel object and releases its resources.
requirements: brgemm must be a valid BRGeMM ukernel object handle obtained from dnnl_brgemm_create.
Do not use brgemm after destruction.
Ensure any required dnnl_brgemm_release_hw_context has been called after all executions; destruction does not replace release (per API separation).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_transform_create
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_transform_create(dnnl_transform_t *transform, dnnl_dim_t K, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_pack_type_t in_pack_type, dnnl_dim_t in_ld, dnnl_dim_t out_ld, dnnl_data_type_t in_dt, dnnl_data_type_t out_dt);
functions.description: Creates a transform object to convert/pack data with specified K, N, packing type, leading dimensions, and data types.
requirements: transform must be a non-null output pointer to receive the created object.
in_pack_type must be one of dnnl_pack_type_no_trans or dnnl_pack_type_trans (as stated).
in_ld and out_ld must reflect the input layout and the output layout; when packing, out_ld specifies the block by N dimension.
K and N must match the dimensions of the data to be transformed.
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and do not use the output on failure.

functions.name: dnnl_transform_generate
functions.description: Generates the executable component of a transform object based on its current configuration.
requirements: transform must be a valid transform object created by dnnl_transform_create.

Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_transform_execute
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_transform_execute(const_dnnl_transform_t transform, const void *in_ptr, void *out_ptr);
functions.description: Executes a transform to convert/pack data from in_ptr to out_ptr according to the transform configuration.
requirements: transform must be a valid generated transform object.
in_ptr must be a valid pointer to the input buffer.
out_ptr must be a valid pointer to the output buffer with sufficient space for the transform result.

functions.name: dnnl_threadpool_interop_sgemm

requirements: transa and transb indicate whether to transpose A and/or B; valid flags are not specified here, but typically BLAS-style values like 'N'/'T' are used (exact accepted set is not documented in this header).

A, B, and C must point to valid, sufficiently large memory regions consistent with M, N, K, and the leading dimensions.
lda, ldb, ldc must be positive and consistent with the layout implied by transa/transb and the matrix sizes (exact constraints are not specified in this header).
threadpool must point to a threadpool interface object when using the THREADPOOL CPU runtime; must be non-null for threaded execution (nullability behavior is not specified here).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl_threadpool_interop_gemm_u8s8s32
functions.signature: dnnl_status_t DNNL_API dnnl_threadpool_interop_gemm_u8s8s32(char transa, char transb, char offsetc, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const uint8_t *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, uint8_t ao, const int8_t *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, int8_t bo, float beta, int32_t *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc, const int32_t *co, void *threadpool);

requirements: transa and transb indicate whether to transpose A and/or B; valid flags are not specified here (typically BLAS-style).
offsetc controls how the offset array co is interpreted; specific valid values and rules are not specified in this header (consult dnnl_gemm_u8s8s32 documentation).
M, N, K must be non-negative dimensions.
A (uint8_t), B (int8_t), and C (int32_t) must point to valid, sufficiently large memory consistent with M, N, K, and leading dimensions.
lda, ldb, ldc must be positive and consistent with the matrix layouts (exact constraints are not specified here).
ao (uint8_t) and bo (int8_t) are input zero-point offsets; acceptable ranges are those of their types.
co (const int32_t*) must be valid if required by offsetc; when offsetc indicates no per-row/column offsets, co may be unused (exact rules not specified here).
threadpool must point to a threadpool interface object when using the THREADPOOL CPU runtime; must be non-null for threaded execution (nullability behavior is not specified here).
Check the returned dnnl_status_t and handle errors.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::get_num_threads
functions.description: Returns the number of worker threads in this thread pool. Typically used by oneDNN to size parallel regions and to determine available parallelism.
requirements: No explicit preconditions documented.
May be called from any thread; function is const.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::get_in_parallel
functions.description: Returns true if the calling thread currently belongs to (is executing within) this thread pool. Useful to avoid oversubscription or recursive parallelism.
requirements: No explicit preconditions documented.
May be called from any thread; function is const.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::parallel_for
functions.signature: virtual void dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::parallel_for(int n, const std::function<void(int, int)> &fn)
functions.description: Submits n instances of a closure for parallel execution by the thread pool, invoking fn(i, n) for i in [0, n). If the ASYNCHRONOUS flag is set (get_flags() & ASYNCHRONOUS), this function returns immediately and completion must be synchronized separately via wait().
requirements: Argument n must be a non-negative integer (the number of tasks to submit).
Argument fn must be a valid callable with signature void(int, int) and must remain valid for the duration of execution.
If get_flags() & ASYNCHRONOUS is non-zero, the caller must ensure completion (e.g., by calling wait()) before relying on the effects of submitted tasks.
fn may be invoked concurrently on multiple threads for different i; any shared state accessed by fn must be safe for concurrent access (inferred from parallel execution semantics).

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::get_flags
functions.description: Returns a bit mask of thread pool behavior flags. Currently defined flag: ASYNCHRONOUS (1) indicating parallel_for returns immediately and completion must be managed via wait().
requirements: No explicit preconditions documented.
May be called from any thread; function is const.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::wait
functions.description: Synchronizes with previously submitted work. If the thread pool is synchronous, wait() is a no-op. If ASYNCHRONOUS is set, wait() blocks until all previously submitted jobs have completed.
requirements: If get_flags() & ASYNCHRONOUS is non-zero, the caller should invoke wait() at appropriate synchronization points to ensure all submitted closures have finished before consuming their results or destroying related resources.
No other explicit preconditions documented.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::threadpool_iface::~threadpool_iface
functions.description: Virtual destructor for the thread pool interface. Allows deletion via a base-class pointer. No special behavior is documented beyond defaulted destruction.
requirements: No explicit preconditions documented for destruction.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::make_stream
functions.description: Constructs a oneDNN execution stream bound to a specific engine and a user-provided threadpool. Intended for executing primitives on a given engine using the provided threadpool for parallel work scheduling. Throws dnnl::error on failure via wrap_c_api.
requirements: aengine must be a valid, initialized dnnl::engine associated with the intended device/runtime.
threadpool must point to an object that implements dnnl::threadpool_iface.
The function may throw dnnl::error on failure; callers should be prepared to catch exceptions.

The created stream can later be used with oneDNN primitives; ensure the threadpool object remains valid while the stream may use it (lifetime considerations are implied, exact policy not documented here).

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::get_threadpool
functions.description: Retrieves the threadpool associated with a given execution stream. Returns nullptr if the stream was created without a threadpool. Throws dnnl::error on failure via wrap_c_api.
requirements: astream must be a valid dnnl::stream.
The returned pointer may be null if no threadpool was associated; callers must handle a null result.
The function may throw dnnl::error on failure; callers should be prepared to catch exceptions.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::sgemm
functions.signature: inline status sgemm(char transa, char transb, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const float *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, const float *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, float beta, float *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc, threadpool_iface *threadpool)
functions.description: Threadpool-enabled single-precision GEMM: computes C := alpha*op(A)*op(B) + beta*C with op(X) = X or X^T (or conjugate transpose if supported), executing work on the provided threadpool. Returns a oneDNN status code.
requirements: transa and transb must indicate the operation on A and B; by BLAS convention these are typically 'N' (no transpose), 'T' (transpose), or 'C' (conjugate transpose).
M, N, K should be non-negative dimensions.
Matrix pointers A, B, and C must be non-null when the corresponding problem size implies access (e.g., when M, N, K are non-zero).
Leading dimensions must be valid per GEMM conventions: lda >= max(1, (transa == 'N' ? M : K)); ldb >= max(1, (transb == 'N' ? K : N)); ldc >= max(1, M).
threadpool must be a non-null pointer to an object implementing dnnl::threadpool_iface.
Return value is a status code; callers must check the returned status for success or failure.

functions.name: dnnl::threadpool_interop::gemm_u8s8s32
functions.signature: inline status gemm_u8s8s32(char transa, char transb, char offsetc, dnnl_dim_t M, dnnl_dim_t N, dnnl_dim_t K, float alpha, const uint8_t *A, dnnl_dim_t lda, uint8_t ao, const int8_t *B, dnnl_dim_t ldb, int8_t bo, float beta, int32_t *C, dnnl_dim_t ldc, const int32_t *co, threadpool_iface *threadpool)
functions.description: Threadpool-enabled integer GEMM with asymmetric zero-points: computes an int32 accumulator GEMM using uint8 A, int8 B, and int32 C with floating-point scaling alpha/beta and per-matrix (or per-row/column) offsets. Execution is scheduled on the provided threadpool. Returns a oneDNN status code.
